prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE reusable game ground decal asset: a narrow elongated irregular strip of damp dark taupe earth, tiny limestone grit, fine roots, very low desaturated olive moss and occasional short dry winter grass at a medieval fortress foundation. Transparent background, clean feathered organic alpha, no rectangular backing. The strip lies on a flat ground plane in 2:1 isometric perspective but its long axis runs horizontally across the image, 5:1 width-to-height silhouette. Detailed hand-painted realistic strategy game art, subdued natural colors, small surface detail, soft diffuse light, minimal cast shadow. Sparse low moss concentrated in uneven broken groups, most surface is earth with scattered fine stones. No wall, no building, no paving floor, no large rocks, no flowers, no text, no UI, no white outline. Center the entire isolated strip with generous transparent margin. It will be fitted along foundations in a snowy warm-limestone fortress, so keep muted winter browns and olive greens.

Use case: stylized-concept. One small isolated transparent game sprite of LOW creeping olive moss with very sparse short dry winter grass, tiny limestone chips, fine brown roots and a little dark soil. Irregular elongated ground-hugging cluster, width about three times its height, viewed in 2:1 isometric ground perspective, detailed hand-painted realistic medieval strategy art. Desaturated yellow olive and warm grey brown palette matching a snowy limestone fortress. Concentrate low velvet moss in two uneven patches separated by bare earth. Only a few fine straw-colored grass tips, no bushes or large leaves. Soft diffuse light. Clean feathered alpha, fully transparent background, no backing floor, no wall, no building, no text, no large stones, no flowers, no snow, no strong cast shadow. Generous transparent margin around the single cluster.
